notes: Event date: German Wikipedia, 8. current_activity: 157th Mountain Division staff reaches the Bologna area; division under the XIV Panzer Corps (reserve)
notes: Event date: German Wikipedia, 8. Gebirgs-Division (Wehrmacht): on 17 December 1944 the division was ordered, as a reserve of Army Group C, under the XIV Panzer Corps into the former billeting area of the 29th Panzergrenadier Division near Bologna; the divisional staff arrived in the Bologna area on 18 December 1944; the war diary of the XIV Panzer Corps (KTB Nr. 7) records the arrival of single companies from 18 to 31 December, with the first parts on 21 December. The Western Alps positions were taken over by the 5th Mountain Division.
